blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Explicit true: the current Celo CHFm owner can authorize a burner that directly burns an arbitrary holder balance. This direct freeze/blacklist-equivalent capability is distinct from the transfer-review lane and does not suppress upstream USDm exposure.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Celo proxy 0xb55a79f398e759e43c95b979163f30ec87ee131d resolves to StableTokenV3 0x815795c30d0758a297b08cd4e0643620c974c318, owned by the 4-of-6 Safe 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 at Celo block 80489715. StableTokenV3 owner-only setBurner/setOperator and role-gated burn(address,uint256)/sendToPool are at L153-L183: https://github.com/mento-protocol/mento-core/blob/07ecf3df5650a33ea6957f1ad2966e02c5082253/contracts/tokens/StableTokenV3.sol#L153-L183. Complete BurnerUpdated history (latest assignment block 65399198) lists the four current burners and Broker’s false state: https://celo.blockscout.com/api/v2/addresses/0xb55a79f398e759e43c95b979163f30ec87ee131d/logs?topic=0xf0e5abe4ab32ea692e3889b4c146fd4ddae5f17bb40ab4feba97fb67a2d4de0f. OperatorUpdated history identifies only StabilityPool 0xc415ca43ab6ab246e64559696b8dcacdd08a39e8 as operator: https://celo.blockscout.com/api/v2/addresses/0xb55a79f398e759e43c95b979163f30ec87ee131d/logs?topic=0x966c160e1c4dbc7df8d69af4ace01e9297c3cf016397b7914971f2fbfa32672d. Current minters from complete MinterUpdated history are ActivePool 0x9947CEe121586fC31b0b0a162A40D6516979E7cB and BorrowerOperations 0x7Fe90CF5A41473179fCE89Df55bc9afcd1c5c0be; Broker is false: https://celo.blockscout.com/api/v2/addresses/0xb55a79f398e759e43c95b979163f30ec87ee131d/logs?topic=0xb21afb9ce9be0a676f8f317ff0ca072fb89a4f8ce2d1b6fe80f8755c14f1cb19. Blockscout identifies 0x9947CEe121586fC31b0b0a162A40D6516979E7cB as ActivePool: https://celo.blockscout.com/api/v2/addresses/0x9947CEe121586fC31b0b0a162A40D6516979E7cB. Verified source paths burn msg.sender in BorrowerOperations (L728, L1091), TroveManager (L919), CollateralRegistry (L133, L217); StabilityPool deposits msg.sender (L277), burns address(this) (L490), and returns from address(this) (L616): https://github.com/mento-protocol/bold/blob/858ef07a497d748cdf65c602a56b4de901d4080e/contracts/src/BorrowerOperations.sol#L728-L1091; https://github.com/mento-protocol/bold/blob/858ef07a497d748cdf65c602a56b4de901d4080e/contracts/src/TroveManager.sol#L919; https://github.com/mento-protocol/bold/blob/858ef07a497d748cdf65c602a56b4de901d4080e/contracts/src/CollateralRegistry.sol#L133-L217; https://github.com/mento-protocol/bold/blob/858ef07a497d748cdf65c602a56b4de901d4080e/contracts/src/StabilityPool.sol#L277-L616. On material Monad, StableTokenSpoke exposes only self-burn `burn(uint256)` (L100-L114), and NttManager pulls msg.sender’s tokens before burning its own balance (L409, L429): https://github.com/mento-protocol/mento-core/blob/main/contracts/tokens/StableTokenSpoke.sol#L100-L114; https://github.com/mento-protocol/mento-stabletoken-ntt/blob/main/evm/src/NttManager/NttManager.sol#L404-L429. The same owner Safe can grant a new burner/operator, establishing Possible.

oracleRisk.summary: CHFm's sole Celo CDP branch values USDm through one Mento SortedOracles CHF/USD report, inverted by FXPriceFeed. OracleAdapter enforces FX market hours, BreakerBox bidirectional mode, and a 360-second report expiry; there is no alternate provider. An invalid or unavailable rate freezes price-dependent operations until the authorized watchdog permanently shuts the branch and pins the last valid price.

branchApplicability.rationale: Mento's pinned Celo deployment registry exposes one CHFm Liquity branch. At finalized Celo block 72135701, its live CollateralRegistry returned one collateral, USDm as token 0, and the CHFm TroveManager as manager 0; no additional CHFm collateral branch exists.

branches.label: Mento CHFm / USDm branch
branches.summary: The live CHFm branch uses one Mento SortedOracles CHF/USD report with a 360-second token expiry, a 110% MCR, Stability Pool offset, and active-Trove redistribution. Price-dependent calls freeze on invalid data until watchdog shutdown; there is no alternate oracle provider.

feeds.path: One CHF/USD SortedOracles report -> OracleAdapter market-hours, BreakerBox, and 360-second freshness validation -> FXPriceFeed inversion -> USDm-backed CHFm Trove collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: FXPriceFeed reads rateFeedID 0x0f61BA9c30ef7CaEE7E5CC1F96BFFCb0f52ccD64 through OracleAdapter 0xa472fBBF4b890A54381977ac392BdF82EeC4383a and inverts it. At finalized block 72135701, one report was live, its timestamp was 51 seconds old against a 360-second expiry, trading was bidirectional, and the FX market was open. No alternate provider exists: stale, closed-market, suspended, or invalid data makes price reads revert until watchdog 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 irreversibly shuts the branch, after which FXPriceFeed returns lastValidPrice.

collateralParameters.note: The live SystemParams proxy returned MCR 110%, CCR 135%, SCR 110%, and BCR 10%; TroveManager shutdownTime was zero at finalized Celo block 72135701.

branches.liquidationMechanism: At Celo block 80633000, getTroveIdsCount() returned 1. The runtime-matched TroveManager calls _closeTrove(..., Status.closedByLiquidation), which unconditionally requires more than one Trove for liquidations and reverts OnlyOneTroveLeft for this state, including after shutdown. Ordinary liquidation of the sole current Trove is therefore uncallable. Stability Pool balances do not bypass this guard.
branches.backstop: Stability Pool 0xc415cA43aB6Ab246E64559696b8DCAcdd08A39e8 is the first backstop. It held 5,000 CHFm at finalized block 72135701; liquidation logic leaves the configured 1 CHFm minimum untouched. Debt beyond available offsets is redistributed with collateral across active Troves through DefaultPool; the branch graph and pinned implementation expose no separate insurance or reserve absorber.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Residual liquidation debt beyond the Stability Pool is assigned pro rata to active Troves, and the last Trove cannot be liquidated. If branch TCR falls below the 110% SCR, anyone can shut the branch down; the authorized watchdog can also permanently shut it after oracle failure. Shutdown stops new borrowing and interest accrual and enables urgent redemption at the last valid price, burning CHFm for USDm even against the final Trove.

branchKindReviews.rationale: Pinned Celo block 80633000 (hash 0x6254260b5e4040172e1f1dde1e5f4d8eb9b2b9115e3f69fd2d314df5d04d613f; 2026-10-20T22:02:38Z) binds CHFm FXPriceFeed 0x8a94073809e9ae55626c2fd413826bf93f755a73 to rateFeedID 0x0f61ba9c30ef7caee7e5cc1f96bffcb0f52ccd64 and OracleAdapter 0xa472fbbf4b890a54381977ac392bdf82eec4383a, whose SortedOracles is 0xefb84935239dacdecf7c5ba76d8de40b077b7b33. getOracles(feed) returned the singleton 0x1b904277b22ca598ef17b38f64de5f9c29cd31bd. The feed implementation runtime matches verified source: normal reads use this path; lastValidPrice is available after permanent shutdown, not independent live failover. Only this feed kind is refreshed; sibling historical observations retain their dates.

At Celo block 80633000, CollateralRegistry 0x8530ee22a4adc37b02d1cd37fc120508663fedf8 identifies one USDm collateral and TroveManager 0x4e105fef015db26320c077427bd605acead9262e for CHFm. The manager's getTroveIdsCount() returned 1 and shutdownTime() returned 0. Its deployed runtime exactly matches verified source: _closeTrove requires more than one Trove whenever closedStatus is closedByLiquidation, regardless of shutdown. This is measured current uncallability, not a missing delay or an inferred zero-second path. Re-review on a Trove census or implementation change; no other branch kind is renewed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Celo is CHFm's native Mento CDP issuance hub. Monad is a CHFmSpoke representation using Wormhole NTT burn/mint, while the Celo-side NTT manager locks native CHFm for the outbound path; these manager and transceiver controls are bridge machinery and do not add a second native mint authority.

protocols.name: Mento Wormhole Native Token Transfer
protocols.note: The issuer configuration defines a locking Celo CHFm NTT manager and a burning Monad CHFm spoke manager.

routes.reviewNote: The Monad deployment is the CHFmSpoke representation: the NTT manager points to this token, returns burning mode, and is owned by the Mento Safe at the current observation block.

controls.label: CHFm Wormhole NTT manager
controls.capDescription: The official CHFm NTT configuration sets a 200,000 CHFm outbound limit on each leg with matching per-peer inbound limits; the Mento Safe controls the route manager.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: The Celo NTT manager returns the native CHFm token and locking mode; the Monad manager returns the CHFmSpoke token and burning mode.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The official NTT configuration pairs the Celo and Monad managers through the Wormhole transceiver.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: The NTT manager returns getThreshold() = 1 and uses one Wormhole transceiver/guardian validation path.
routeChecks.rateLimits: The official configuration sets 200,000e18 CHFm outbound on each leg and matching per-peer inbound limits.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Both NTT manager proxies are owned by the Mento Safe; the Monad manager implementation is 0x0fa667eaf4a4956316137bf9b4786812d988dc35 and its proxy-admin slot is zero at block 96583399.
routeChecks.caps: Manager ownership and route configuration can change the bridge limits; this is bridge accounting rather than independent native issuance.

controls.evidence: At Celo block 75010744 (2026-08-16), the NTT manager at 0xbbfbe2791722e93f27c5ce80e3725c8dd8d09697 returned token() = 0xb55a79f398e759e43c95b979163f30ec87ee131d, getMode() = 0 (locking), and owner() = the 4-of-6 Mento Safe. At Monad block 96583399, the same manager address returned token() = 0xf64e91ffef7ef43aa314f0bc2ac39f770797990c, getMode() = 1 (burning), and the same owner. The manager is a bridge route controller on both deployments; it does not establish independent Monad liabilities.

controls.label: CHFm Wormhole NTT transceiver

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The official NTT configuration binds the Celo locking manager and Monad burning manager to the Wormhole transceiver.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: The NTT manager threshold is 1 and the route relies on one Wormhole transceiver/guardian validation path.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The transceiver is owned by the Mento Safe; its implementation is 0x4abda2f81b54cd48f8ada60ce86b876f25a697f5 and both proxy-admin slots are zero at the Monad observation block.

controls.evidence: The deterministic CHFm NTT transceiver proxy is deployed on both Celo and Monad and is owned by the Mento Safe. At the Monad observation block its implementation slot resolves to 0x4abda2f81b54cd48f8ada60ce86b876f25a697f5, while the NTT manager reports one transceiver validation path. This validator, upgrade, admin, and pause exposure is retained under Bridge Risk for the Celo locking and Monad burning route.
